sections.title: Talk about future plans
sections.content: Use *ir a* + infinitive to say what *you* are going to do. The form of *ir* changes with the person, and the main verb stays in the infinitive.

items.english: I am going to travel tomorrow.
I am going to study this afternoon.
We are going to go to the park.

sections.content: Remember the pattern: *ir* + *a* + infinitive. For example, *voy a viajar*, not *voy viajar.
